name: habblaud-remote
displayName: Habblaud: send this machine's sessions to a central Habblaud
description: Asynchronous hooks that send what each Claude Code session does (prompts, tools, subagents, waits, GitHub results) to a Habblaud server on another machine (HABBLAUD_SERVER_URL + HABBLAUD_SERVER_TOKEN). Fire-and-forget: they never block the session.
